title: A conjecture on Davenport constants of cosets is false as stated
summary: d_β(G) = d_{β∖α}(G) fails for G = ℤ/4.
source: J. Kettinger, G. Moles, "Elasticity of Orders from the S-relative Davenport Constant: an Arithmetic Application of a Number-Theoretic Investigation", arXiv:2605.17595v2 (v1 17 May 2026, v2 14 July 2026), Conjecture 2.17.
label: lean
